agent.note: Two cautions for anyone reading this. First, every quote, statistic, bill, incident and named person's action here is invented by the simulator — including the "47% AI-authored commits" figure, the hospital ransomware attack, and all attributed statements by Anthropic, its leadership, other labs, governments and media; none of it is a forecast or a description of real internal practice.
